title: UK probes Meta over ‘exploitative’ new terms for media

blocks.text: LONDON – Britain’s competition watchdog Friday opened an investigation into whether Meta was imposing “exploitative” new terms allowing it to use media content for its own products, including AI, without giving publishers adequate choice.
